thread:
Maya: FYI reproducible issue in Node quickstart: request id lost after SDK auth-refresh retry, app logs show "reqId=null". Repro steps in repo.
Theo: Which repo/branch?
Maya: `github.com/redwood-inference/quickstarts/node-telemetry` branch `telemetry-fix`. Run with:
```
npm ci
LOG_LEVEL=debug node sampleapp.js
curl -H "X-Req-Id: foo-123" http://localhost:3000/generate
```
On first attempt id present, on automatic auth-refresh retry the retried internal request has no X-Req-Id.
Priya: Might be the SDK retry building a new Request without copying headers. Node-fetch/undici behavior differs from python requests.
Theo: Are we using OpenTelemetry express middleware to attach req id to spans? If that runs after auth check then internal retries (which are triggered by the SDK before the middleware re-runs) won't see it.
Maya: Exactly. Our express middleware currently enriches logs/spans at route handler time. The SDK does an auth token refresh that triggers a background call, not going through the same middleware chain.
Priya: Short-term fix: copy incoming headers into the retry call inside the SDK. Long-term: propagate a correlation id via AsyncLocalStorage so internal library calls can inherit it. Sample snippet:```
const als = new AsyncLocalStorage();
app.use((req,res,next)=>{ als.run({reqId: req.get('X-Req-Id')||generate()}, ()=>next()) });
// later in SDK internals: const ctx = als.getStore(); fetch(..., {headers: {...ctx?.reqId && {'X-Req-Id': ctx.reqId}}})
```
Theo: Good idea. Also follow-up: redaction order. If redaction runs before span enrichment we may mask the id in app logs but leave it visible in lower-level libs that log later. Need to ensure redaction is the final step before write.
Maya: Opened PR 523 to copy headers in retry + add unit tests. I added an integration test that simulates auth refresh and asserts no "undefined"/null req id appears.
ops-bot: canary-deploy: quickstart-telemetry canary failed 2025-02-03T17:02Z :warning: logs show header mismatch.
Priya: For parity, note Python quickstart wasn't affected because requests.Session preserves headers; we should add parity test to ensure Node/Python show same behavior under auth-refresh.
Theo: Also add a fuzz test for redaction ordering (run with noisy logger at debug and ensure regexp matches redact patterns in all outputs).
Maya: I'll update README to suggest LOG_LEVEL=info when onboarding to avoid masking real errors with debug spam, and add a short note in the DX checklist about AsyncLocalStorage for req-id propagation.
Priya: Thanks. After PR merges please bump SDK patch and update CHANGELOG + add a short note in the SDK migration guide.
Theo: Reviewed and left one comment about not leaking session tokens into logs when copying headers; ensure we filter sensitive headers.
Maya: Will add header whitelist and rerun tests. :thumbsup:
